title: Word
description: Exposes Microsoft Word document operations as agent tools.

Read text, create documents from paragraph lists, append text, find/replace text, and export to PDF. Operates on docx files in the acting user's OneDrive via the Microsoft Graph drive content API, round-tripping through python-docx.
Authenticates via an Entra app (client credentials) or user OAuth.

word.access.title: Access level
word.access.description: Graph scopes to request. readonly: read document text only. write: full read/write (create, append, replace text, export PDF).
